notes.title: Update Notes - 06/24/2025
notes.content:
Update Notes - 06/24/2025 
Fixed an issue where the Succubus incorrectly judged the milking condition when her skill was fully leveled.

After corruption, the Succubus will now automatically activate the Monitor feature.

Partial translation corrections.

notes.title: Update Notes - 06/20/2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you all for your continued support and for actively reporting issues! We’ve received several reports about the skill book for "Adventurer - Ira" not being clickable. Since this issue may significantly impact gameplay, we’ve released a small update in an effort to address it. 

While our team is still investigating and cannot yet pinpoint the exact cause, this update includes additional logic checks to help resolve potential abnormalities. If you’re experiencing this issue, please make sure to update the game to the latest version and restart the game or Steam. 

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. We’ll continue monitoring the situation and work toward a complete fix. Thank you again for your patience and support! 🙇‍♂️ 



Update Notes - 06/20/2025 

Improve the skill unlock logic after the womb tattoo is unlocked.

FPS lock added 

Various balance and UI optimizations for the demo version

notes.title: Handyman Fantasy Demo is Now Live!
notes.content:
Ding-ding! 🎉
The Handyman Fantasy demo is now available for early access!

Although the Steam Next Fest officially starts next Tuesday,
we decided to release the demo today so everyone can enjoy the game over the weekend 🤗
The demo is now live on our Steam page—curious gentlemen, come give it a try!
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43526948/40250d6529ad408140ca5cc7af0997247d778588.png


🛠️ Demo Content Includes:


 All currently available heroines
 Lewd Level available: LV0–LV1
 Dungeon Levels: D to B
 Some shop items
 Some upgradable skills

⚠️ Demo progress will not carry over to the full version

We’ve run many tests, but due to our limited team size, there may still be bugs.
If you encounter any issues while playing, please leave us a comment—we’ll fix it ASAP!

Wishing you all a great time with the game~ 💕


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690010/Handyman_Fantasy/
💖 And don’t forget to add us to your wishlist!

notes.title: 2025/02/10 Development Progress (Steam Page Finally Live!!)
notes.content:
Ahh… I’m overwhelmed with emotions இдஇ
Finally, finally… our Steam page has passed the review and is officially online!! 🎉🎉🎉

Everyone, please make sure to add the game to your wishlist! This is the biggest encouragement for our development team!!

(By the way, the current PV is only a temporary version! A more refined and visually stunning trailer will be produced in the future, so please look forward to it!! ✨)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/ddd729f1f588c9c1ca5138cda85972061fec8fde.png
Starting from this update, our development logs will also be posted here. There are already five previous logs, so if you're interested in our past progress, feel free to check them out on X (Twitter) or Ci-en!

Do you remember the “Dungeon Exploration of Female Adventurers” mentioned in the previous article?
Have you noticed the heart icon on the right side of the screen?
Today, let’s introduce this feature! ✨
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/06cae7329dd0049b00f8e041667db0b79344f8e0.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/a6b9bf3517a5e099bf896b0f66ad087192e331a5.png
Due to a certain event, the protagonist gains the ability to engrave “Lust Marks” on female adventurers.
This ability not only unlocks new appearances for the adventurers but also affects combat mechanics!

Previously, our role was limited to cheering or acting as a meat shield,
but now, we can become true support partners!
Come on, let’s fully support them!! (ლ(◉◞౪◟◉ )ლ)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/fdfe763da724e2b1cd7b4c8b3c249f2b5d4fab6b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/fcc245356706724e332ece0a5587ff4235c04580.png
🔹 Tentacle ON/OFF Function & “Arousal” System Implemented! 🔹
✅ Tentacle mechanics can be turned ON or OFF freely!
✅ Continuously supporting adventurers may put them in an “Aroused” state!
✅ In this state, their reactions will change!?

In other words, the number of times you support them could have a significant impact on the battle…!? (Interpret that as you will...)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/f6ae4f3a6cac662abcc2870d99ee760777d28d33.png
After battles, players can use the “Unlocking Skill” to open treasure chests!
However… 💀 Failure might make the female adventurers angry!? ( ˘•ω•˘ )

Additionally, aside from interacting with the female characters,
exploring different areas of the otherworld is also a key game element!

Depending on game progress, time, and character intimacy levels,
special event CGs may be triggered…!?
Don’t miss out—collect all CGs and aim for the perfect ending!! 🔥
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/819232aef8d21b63cde94c87975de33132eb9245.png

💡 Development Progress  💡
Due to the Steam review process,
the programming side has undergone multiple adjustments, causing slight delays 💦
However!

🎨 The art is now over 80% complete!! 🎨

Now that the Steam page is live,
we can finally focus on overall integration work!
From here on, development speed will be fully accelerated!! 💪🔥

One Last Request!
✨ Please add "Handyman Fantasy" to your wishlist! ✨
Stay updated with the latest news!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690010/Handyman_Fantasy/
We sincerely appreciate your support!! (≧▽≦)
